psychology_driven_websites.description: A website approach focused on trust, cognitive ease, reduced friction, emotional confidence and conversion.
psychology_driven_websites.expanded_positioning: GrowwWave does not simply make a website look good. The experience can be structured around how the target customer perceives information, builds trust, evaluates value, handles objections and decides whether to take action.
psychology_driven_websites.business_specific_personalization: GrowwWave analyzes the type of business, its audience, customer behavior, buying journey and conversion requirements, then shapes the website experience around that context rather than applying one generic template to every business.

psychology_application_examples.section_placement: Sections can be arranged according to the customer's decision journey rather than arbitrary website conventions.
psychology_application_examples.hero_section: The first screen can prioritize the customer's primary problem, desired outcome, value proposition and relevant trust signals.
psychology_application_examples.typography: Font size, weight, hierarchy and emphasis can guide attention toward the information that matters most.
psychology_application_examples.visual_hierarchy: Important information can be intentionally given stronger visual prominence.
psychology_application_examples.color: Color selection can support brand perception, attention, contrast, emotional tone and CTA visibility. Color psychology is contextual and depends on the brand, audience, industry and desired perception.
psychology_application_examples.cta_placement: Calls-to-action can be positioned around moments where customer intent is strongest, reducing unnecessary friction.
psychology_application_examples.content_density: Copy and information architecture can be structured to reduce cognitive overload.
psychology_application_examples.trust_signals: Relevant proof, safety signals, credibility elements and reassurance can be positioned where uncertainty is likely to occur.
psychology_application_examples.objection_handling: Common customer concerns can be addressed at appropriate points in the decision journey.
psychology_application_examples.mobile_ux: The mobile experience can be designed around thumb-friendly interaction, scanning behavior, reduced friction and shorter decision paths.
psychology_application_examples.conversion_architecture: The complete page structure can guide the visitor from attention → understanding → trust → confidence → action.

psychology_driven_websites.generic_template_rule: Do not imply that GrowwWave applies one generic psychology template to every business; website decisions are contextual and business-specific.

website_differentiation.canonical_question: अगर दूसरी agencies भी websites बनाती हैं, तो GrowwWave की approach actually different कैसे है?
paraphrases: What makes GrowwWave different from other web agencies?
How is a GrowwWave website different?
Why should I choose GrowwWave if others also build websites?
What do you do differently from normal website agencies?
website_differentiation.answer:
### GrowwWave की approach अलग कैसे है?

बहुत-सी agencies website बना सकती हैं। GrowwWave का focus सिर्फ website को अच्छा दिखाने पर नहीं, बल्कि **customer के behaviour और business niche के context में website को strategically design करने** पर है।

**हम क्या देखते हैं:**
- आपके niche के customers किस तरह सोचते और decisions लेते हैं
- कौन-सी information पहले दिखनी चाहिए और किस क्रम में
- sections, images, CTAs और important elements कहाँ place होने चाहिए
- कहाँ friction या confusion कम करनी है
- trust, clarity और action को किस तरह naturally build करना है

इसलिए website सिर्फ pages का collection नहीं होती—उसका **layout, messaging, visual hierarchy और user journey** इस तरह structure किए जाते हैं कि visitor को सही information सही समय पर मिले और next action clear रहे।
